environment: Happy DOM, compiled standalone HTML, canvas pixel buffer and controlled animation queue
checks: Twenty-two compiled-HTML role fixtures cover chain pushes, rear pulls, first-target swaps, bent rays, fixed supports, remote presses, hydraulics and combat.
Global reflection uses nearest-source priority, exchanges equally distant actors and draws shape-specific previews.
A four-mirror returning ray illuminates its path and blinks the Wizard without moving occupants or awarding a false discovery.
Gray-backed buttons and black/gray press centers have the exact expected pixels.
Mirror warnings flash only involved backs, preserve diagonals and lock ordinary controls.
Keys 1/2/3, repeated Tab, all three role buttons and image clicks select correctly without advancing the world; Shift+Tab and off-canvas clicks are respected.
Direction buttons work; Undo, Reset, Restart and level selection interrupt animations without stale frames. Reset clears discoveries and Restart opens the actual tutorial.
Reduced-motion mode paints the final result without timer waits.
Defeat appears only after the combat animation and its Undo restores the three living heroes.
Victory waits for all three heroes and the last frame, disables ordinary controls, and can be undone or restarted.
All eight rooms expose three heroes, three goals, correct titles, objectives, links and contextual help; only level 1 shows the tutorial.
The actual workshop route earns every discovery from displayed public pixels; later rooms add none.
The compiled HTML completes all eight real rooms with every frame and duration checked, including Undo and replay of each completion.
